title: Austin Audit: 1993 Service Plan & Projects
summary:
*   City officials discussed the proposed 1993 Service Plan.
*   Updates were provided on the current status of various ongoing city projects.
*   This was a special meeting of the Audit Committee, focusing on oversight and planning rather than general city governance.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - COUNCIL AUDIT COMMITTEE
THIRD FLOOR CONFERECE ROOM - 1:00 P.M.
October 28, 1992
Mayor Todd called to order the special called meeting of the Council Audit Committee,
noting the presence of Councilmembers Garcia, Larson and Reynolds.
The Committee discussed the following, vith reports and comments from appropriate staff:
1. 1993 Service Plan
2. Status of Projects
The meeting was adjourned at 2:10 P.M.
